name.str_pl: books of philosophy

description: A deep discussion of morality with an emphasis on epistemology and logic.

name.str_pl: copies of Beyond Good and Evil

variants.description: This is a copy of Nietzsche's "Beyond Good and Evil".  Its cover is dog-eared and creased.

name.str_pl: copies of The Unique and Its Property

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Unique and Its Property" by Max Stirner.  A modern translation by Wolfi Landstreicher.

name.str_pl: copies of Madness and Civilization

variants.description: A large, extended version of "Madness and Civilization" by Michel Foucault.  The cover features a striking image of a Panopticonic Prison.

name.str: The Postmodern Condition: A Report on Knowledge
name.str_pl: copies of The Postmodern Condition: A Report on Knowledge

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Postmodern Condition: A Report on Knowledge" by Lyotard.

name.str_pl: copies of Jacques Derrida essays

variants.description: A collection of texts and essays by Jacques Derrida.  Its pages are loose and yellowed - you should probably handle it with care.

name.str_pl: copies of Society of the Spectacle

variants.description: This is a copy of "Society of the Spectacle" by Guy Debord.  Its cover shows rows of adults staring placidly into a screen.

name.str: An Ethic of Sexual Difference and This Sex Which Is Not One
name.str_pl: copies of An Ethic of Sexual Difference and This Sex Which Is Not One

variants.description: This is a split copy of both "An Ethic of Sexual Difference" and "This Sex Which Is Not One" by Luce Irigaray.

name.str_pl: copies of Simulation and Simulacra

variants.description: This is a copy of Baudrillard's "Simulation and Simulacra".  The cover contains an image of a man holding a colored pill in each hand, with the caption "Welcome to the Desert of the Real.".  You think you've seen this movie.

name.str_pl: copies of Existentialism and Humanism

variants.description: This is a small, pocket version of Sartre's "Existentialism and Humanism".  It looks to have been used as a coaster in a past life.

name.str_pl: copies of Practical Ethics

variants.description: This is a copy of "Practical Ethics" by Peter Singer.  From the local university press.

name.str_pl: copies of Industrial Society and Its Future

variants.description: This is a photocopied spiral-bound copy of "Industrial Society and Its Future" by 'Freedom Club'.  The original looks to have been written on a typewriter before being copied.

name.str_pl: copies of Industrial Society and Its Future

variants.description: This is a copy of "Industrial Society and Its Future" by Ted Kaczynski.  Its cover is an image of a hand-crafted wooden box filled with wiring and an ominous looking metal tube.  Provocative.

name.str_pl: copies of Reader on Hegel's Dialectics

variants.description: This is a small reader on Hegel's Dialectics.

name.str_pl: copies of The State and Revolution

variants.description: This is a copy of "The State and Revolution" by Vladimir Lenin.  In English, thankfully.

name.str_pl: copies of In Defense of Marxism

variants.description: This is a copy of "In Defense of Marxism" by Leon Trotsky.

name.str_pl: copies of Steal This Book

variants.description: This is a copy of "Steal This Book" by Abbie Hoffman.  There is a security tag on the back cover.  It appears to still be active.

name.str: Walden: Or Life In The Woods
name.str_pl: copies of Walden: Or Life In The Woods

variants.description: This is a copy of "Walden: Or Life In The Woods" by Henry David Thoreau.  It contains a dried and pressed leaf as a bookmark.

name.str_pl: copies of The Female Eunuch

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Female Eunuch" by Germaine Greer.  A child has scribbled over the contents page in red crayon.

name.str_pl: copies of An Introduction to Metaphysics

variants.description: This is a copy of "An Introduction to Metaphysics" by Bergson.

name.str: The Four Fundamental Concepts of Psychoanalysis
name.str_pl: copies of The Four Fundamental Concepts of Psychoanalysis

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Four Fundamental Concepts of Psychoanalysis" by Jacques Lacan.

name.str_pl: copies of The Prince

variants.description: This is a copy of Machiavelli's "The Prince".  With intro by Q. Skinner.

name.str_pl: copies of The Revolution of Everyday Life

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Revolution of Everyday Life" by Raoul Vaneigem.

name.str_pl: copies of An Essay on Liberation

variants.description: This is a pocket copy of "An Essay on Liberation" by Herbert Marcuse.  The cover contains an image of a pelican.

name.str_pl: copies of Either-Or

variants.description: This is a copy of "Either-Or" by Søren Kierkegaard.

name.str_pl: copies of Allegory of the Cave

variants.description: This is a copy of "Allegory of the Cave" by Plato.

name.str_pl: copies of Leviathan

variants.description: This is a copy of "Leviathan" by Thomas Hobbes.

name.str_pl: copies of Critique Of Pure Reason

variants.description: This is a copy of "Critique Of Pure Reason" by Immanuel Kant.

name.str_pl: copies of Principles of Philosophy

variants.description: This is a copy of "Principles of Philosophy" by René Descartes.

name.str: On the Genealogy of Morality and The Gay Science
name.str_pl: copies of On the Genealogy of Morality and The Gay Science

variants.description: This is a copy of both "On the Genealogy of Morality" and "The Gay Science" by Friederich Nietzsche.

name.str_pl: copies of The Myth of Sisyphus

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Myth of Sisyphus", and other essays, by Albert Camus.  The cover depicts a bare-chested man and a large boulder.

name.str_pl: copies of The Sickness Unto Death

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Sickness Unto Death" by Søren Kierkegaard.  The pages are dotted with post-it notes.

name.str_pl: copies of The Defence of Terrorism

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Defence of Terrorism" by Leon Trotsky.  Despite the title, it does not actually appear to be defending terrorism.

name.str_pl: copies of Enquiry Concerning Political Justice

variants.description: This is a copy of "Enquiry Concerning Political Justice" by William Godwin.  This thick book is filled with antiquated phrases.

name.str: The Abolition of Work and Other Essays
name.str_pl: copies of The Abolition of Work and Other Essays

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Abolition of Work and Other Essays" by Bob Black.  It is likely that "The Abolition of Work" is the most famous essay in this book.

name.str_pl: copies of What is Property?

variants.description: This is a copy of "What is Property?" by Pierre-Joseph Proudhon.  It looks like this book has a surprisingly long track record of owners.

name.str_pl: copies of The Conquest of Bread

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Conquest of Bread" by Peter Kropotkin.  There is a picture of an old philosopher with magnificent beard, instead of bread, on the cover.

name.str_pl: copies of The Trouble with Being Born

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Trouble with Being Born" by Emil Cioran.  This book might have been printed decades before the Cataclysm since the cover is quite weathered.

name.str: The World as Will and Representation
name.str_pl: copies of The World as Will and Representation

variants.description: This is a copy of "The World as Will and Representation" by Arthur Schopenhauer.  It contains a few undecipherable notes and scribbles.

name.str_pl: copies of Up-Wingers: A Futurist Manifesto

variants.description: This is a copy of "Up-Wingers: A Futurist Manifesto" by FM-2030.  It seems that the author's real name is Fereidoun M. Esfandiary.

name.str_pl: copies of The Bastiat Collection

variants.description: This is a copy of "The Bastiat Collection", a large collection of essays by Frederic Bastiat.

name.str_pl: copies of Anarchy, State, and Utopia

variants.description: This is a copy of "Anarchy, State, and Utopia" by Robert Nozick, one of the most influential books of modern libertarianism.

name.str_pl: copies of Socialism

variants.description: This is a copy of "Socialism" by Ludwig von Mises, a critical examination of socialism.

name.str_pl: copies of The ABC of Communism

variants.description: This is a copy of "The ABC of Communism" by Nikolai Bukharin, one of the most influential books of early Marxism-Leninism.

name.str_pl: copies of Anti-Capitalist Mentality

variants.description: This is a copy of "Anti-Capitalist Mentality" by Ludwig von Mises.

name.str_pl: copies of Modal Logic

description: A treatise on applying logical tools to questions about that nature of reality, this book contains detailed discussion of metaphysical issues.

name.str_pl: copies of Aesthetics

description: This hardbound anthology presents a collection of readings, scholarly works, and critical analyses on the subject of beauty.

name.str_pl: copies of The Philosophy of Information

description: This university text details a critical investigation of the conceptual nature and basic principles of information.  The student will gain a thorough appreciation of the conceptual frameworks commonly used to describe and advance semantic investigations.

name.str_pl: copies of Being and Nothingness

description: This paperback is a copy of Jean-Paul Sartre's "Being and Nothingness".  A key work in the existentialist tradition.
